hook: i counted the supplements in my cupboard and then worked out what i'd spent on them
caption: I'm not saying they don't work. I'm saying you have no way of knowing which ones do.
notes: Highest-intent lane in the batch. These people have already spent the money; they're looking for permission to stop guessing. Set the counts to YOUR real cupboard before posting.

slides.text: i counted the supplements in my cupboard and then worked out what i'd spent on them

slides.sub: That was mine. About £60 a month.

slides.text: I started six of them in the same month.
slides.sub: Which means I can't attribute anything to any of them.

slides.text: I started them all in January.
slides.sub: When I felt terrible. I was always going to feel better by March.
No baseline. So there was nothing to compare to.

slides.text: Two of them, I just kept buying.
slides.sub: Not because they worked. Because stopping felt like a risk.
Supplements are cheap enough to keep buying and subtle enough that you can never tell.

slides.text: you don't need to throw them out. you need to find out.
slides.sub: one at a time, two weeks each, one number you don't control. Ren keeps track so you don't have to. link in bio.
